text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hahahaha! Come on, come on!
Hurry it up, Navigator!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
The fine wine of victory,
a magnificent feast—
all that's left is a passionate Dance, and it'll be complete!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's share in this joy together!
Don't forget to look back on today, alright?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"That's right!
Joy is only truly valuable when it is shared!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"If it's with friends you know inside and out,
it doesn't get any better than that!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Cool! You've already got your sights
set on your next voyage!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
You're right.
The adventure—it still continues.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Let's ride this wave of momentum!
Hoist the sails, full speed ahead!!"
